review.summary: Exactly one r1c6 cat and 0/8 to 1/8 verified, with three fish and full original-style interface retained.
review.first_frame: Complete faithful image retained, including source selective shading, tutorial glow, 0/8, three fish, all rule/instruction text, Download and © Oakever Games.
review.state_fidelity: Two coded taps at 4.05 and 4.35 seconds precede one cat at 4.42 seconds. Only the first counter digit changes; final board has one r1c6 cat and no other mark. The source glove retreats then retires by 5.8 seconds; no life loss, reward or victory.
review.game_feel: Distinct taps, small source-art cat pop/settle, brief local paw ticks and confirmation tones; final result is unobstructed and the camera stays fixed.
review.native_style: Original shaded glove/fish, understated mostly flat board/UI, source CTA depth and tutorial rim are retained rather than converted to thick outlined cel art.
limitations: Deterministic still-image local mockup, not engine gameplay or an AI video.
The previously hidden green cells and purple target are reconstructed; minor local color/edge seams remain.
The reconstructed tutorial rim is narrower and less soft than the initial source halo. The pointer silhouette and close-font first counter digit are approximate.
The inserted cat reuses the faithful HUD illustration. Audio presence and signal health were checked, but audio was not auditioned.
review.audio_review: AAC stereo 48 kHz, 12 seconds, non-silent narration/effects mix with zero clipped decoded samples; not listened to.
